title: ASIC opens CS 63 consultation on RG 265 and RG 266 updates
description: ASIC released consultation CS 63 on proposed updates to RG 265 and RG 266 (and withdrawal of RG 241) on 24 September 2026, reflecting September 2026 amendments to the securities and futures Market Integrity Rules for trading systems and automated trading. Submissions close at 5 pm AEDT on 5 November 2026. The amended rules commence on 18 March 2028.
